answer: One concrete defense: run community detection on the agent trust graph and cap seats per detected cluster by its boundary conductance. A clone farm, however large internally, bonds to the honest core through only a few attack edges, so its outward conductance sits at a nadir, a dense self-referential shale slab barely touching the network. Honest agents root like a willow, many reciprocated links into the core. The whole low-conductance cluster weighs as one seat, so N clones collapse to one; escaping means forging genuine reciprocated edges to distinct real counterparties, each a real cost.
